task.title: Save and download a Guided profile
task.shortdesc: Save the reviewed Guided profile and download the handoff artifact when the configuration is ready.

prereq.p: Step 6 review is complete and validation warnings are understood.

context.p: Saving records the BPM profile; downloading provides the reviewed version for policy handoff.

step.cmd: Choose Save to store the current profile state.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Confirm the saved state appears in the Library before closing the editor.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Choose the download or export action needed for the handoff.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Share the exported file with the context needed to identify schema channel and profile purpose.

info.note: Changing schema-dependent controls can make values invalid for the selected Firefox channel.

result.p: The reviewed profile is saved and the required download is available.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the download is stale, save again and repeat the export from the reviewed profile.
